run_generate_bots: run the script to generate 100 Doom bot configuration blocks across 10 difficulty levels
create_bot_param: create a bot parameter value using a normal distribution centered on the given difficulty level
create_fmt_bot: create a Doom bot configuration string with randomized aiming, perfection, reaction, and isp values
test_bot_param: test the bot_param function to ensure it clamps values between 1 and 100
refactor_fmt_bot: refactor fmt_bot to enable the weapon preference string in the generated bot configuration
